description: Combine the shape-local cached n=2048 plus compile-time-specialized n=1024 global-best stack with the barrier-trimmed batch-640 n=512 MathDx pipeline winner. Import only the n=512 operator’s safe removal of barriers between disjoint GEMM/TRSM work and its dedicated launch state; preserve n=1024/n=2048 CuTe schedulers and deterministic n=256 caches, then validate cross-shape resets, repeated outputs, caller-stream ordering, fresh inputs, and the full grid.

Imported only the second parent n512 paired-panel MathDx operator into the first-parent global stack: 18 KiB shape-local shared state, paired loads/stores, and barrier removal between disjoint GEMM/TRSM operations; n1024/n2048 schedulers and deterministic n256 state were preserved. Build, kernelguard/caller-stream policy, all 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells passed. Batch640 n512 measured 1934.572 us and aggregate 930.244 us versus the 923.258 first parent.

Restored only the intra-pair CTA barrier between the two disjoint MathDx TRSMs while retaining both GEMM barrier removals, isolating the launch-state contribution in the combined stack. Build, policy, official tests, fresh-input guard, and full 15-cell grid passed. Batch640 n512 measured 1919.891 us and aggregate 930.717 us versus 1934.572 and 930.244 for the fully trimmed integration; both target samples contained one large timing outlier.

Retained the two intra-pair GEMM barriers but removed the disjoint TRSM barrier, completing the complementary barrier-subset measurement while preserving all shape-local scheduler and cache boundaries. Build, policy, official tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Batch640 n512 measured 1931.165 us and aggregate 929.641 us; the target again included one multi-millisecond outlier, while the aggregate was the lowest of the first three combined samples.

Restored all three intra-pair barriers to measure the untrimmed paired-panel pipeline inside the first-parent global stack. Build, kernelguard/caller-stream policy, official tests, fresh-input guard, and all benchmark cells passed. Batch640 n512 measured 1921.166 us and aggregate 928.713 us; aggregate variation was driven partly by unrelated n2048/large-shape cells, and the n512 target again contained one 6.99 ms outlier.

Restored the exact fully barrier-trimmed n512 region from 0eb632a after subset comparisons; its source-region hash matches the second parent while every surrounding first-parent path remains unchanged. Build, policy, all official tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. Remeasurement was 1944.399 us for batch640 n512 and 929.527 us aggregate versus the earlier 1934.572/930.244 sample; target best samples remained about 1.883 ms but each 200-run mean contained one 8.26/6.94 ms outlier.

Combined only the n512 paired-panel MathDx region and dedicated dynamic-shared launch state with first-parent n1024/n2048/n256 code, then measured fully trimmed, TRSM-barrier-only, GEMM-barriers-only, and all-barriers states. All five trials built and passed kernelguard/caller-stream policy, 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells. Best aggregate sample was 928.713 us at fe49ac2 with all barriers retained; exact fully trimmed source measured 930.244 at a4f2691 and 929.527 at final bfe49af versus 923.258 first parent. Batch640 n512 means ranged 1919.891-1944.399 us, but every 200-run mean contained one 6.1-8.3 ms outlier while best samples were 1.875-1.893 ms. Keep the work moving: a fresh combine could test the later lane-correct cp.async paired-accumulator staging from in-run commit a2f2ef6 atop this n1024/n2048 stack, or isolate robust n512 timing from the recurring single outlier before selecting barrier subsets.
